name: scala-did
description: A Scala & Scala.js implementation of DID and DID Comm messaging spec

paragraphs: A Scala/ScalaJS library for DID and DIDcomm. One of the main goals of this library is to make DID Comm v2 type-safe and easy to use. Made for developers by developers.
The future version of DID Comm v2.1 is being tracked & developed in the branch didcomm-v2.1
I usually say if it compiles it probably also works!
